g.text: Dense per-GPU compute and HBM bandwidth: the bound changes with batch size
AI model: BF16 inputs, weights and outputs; one read of inputs/weights and one output write.
Theoretical bounds, not measurements. M is operator token rows, not conversation concurrency C.
Cache, launches, occupancy and sync also matter. W4A8 cannot borrow a pure-FP4 peak.
